metadata.description: Audio Recap marketplace — distributes the Audio Recap plugin via this repo.

plugins.name: audio-recap
plugins.description: Hear what Claude Code did without watching the screen. After each turn, your Mac's voice speaks a one-sentence recap of what Claude did, then its reply (long replies summarized). Claude Haiku writes the recaps and summaries through your own Claude Code (claude -p), which adds a little model usage. macOS only. Off by default.
